38.0.-1.rawDesc:
The church of Siccara is in the distance to the west as you arrive at the
beginning of a large wooden bridge.  By some odd mystic force the foot boards
and hand rails of this bridge glow while below the soft sounds of a shallow
stream can be heard.  On either side of the face of the bridge covering are
the words "The Glow Bridge".

39.0.-1.rawDesc:
Here the highroad runs through the Mystic Crystal Fields.  Fields of tall
grass are divided right down the middle.  The grass gleams, reflecting the
light to give it the appearance of pale green crystal.

41.0.-1.rawName: A Path To The Mystic Crystal Fields
41.0.-1.rawDesc:
A quiet pathway has been cleared through the tall crystal grasses that
connect the highroad to a hill in the center of the fields.  Ironically enough
it is a wooden fence that borders the path and circles the perimeter of the
Mystic Crystal Fields.

41.0.0.rawDesc:
This hill is in the center of a beautiful field of tall crystal grasses.
The blades of grass are segmented and allows the grass to sway so that in a
breeze the delicate crystal does not shatter.  There are a few gopher holes
on the hillside.
